table fee member ref member, amount money

program:
app "Savings" coin mint
table deposit amount money, note text?
setting monthly money = 5000 "Saved each month"
setting goal money = 100000
let total = sum(deposit.amount)
let left = goal - total
let nm = if(left <= 0, 0, floor(left / monthly) + if(left % monthly > 0, 1, 0))
total "of" goal big
goal total, goal, "saved"
if(left <= 0, "Goal reached", "You reach it around") if(left <= 0, "", monthname(addmonths(today, nm))) head
quick deposit, amount, [2500]
form deposit
list deposit by day
describe:
Savings, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- deposit: amount: money; note: text, optional. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
You can change: "Saved each month": money, starts at 5000; goal: money, starts at 100000.
Works out:
- total is the total amount of deposit.
- left is goal minus total.
- nm is 0 when left is at most 0, otherwise left divided by monthly rounded down plus 1 when left leaves over when divided by monthly is more than 0, otherwise 0.
Shows:
- text: total, "of", goal.
- total out of goal with a progress bar, labelled "saved".
- text: "Goal reached" when left is at most 0, otherwise "You reach it around", "" when left is at most 0, otherwise the month of today moved by nm months.
- one-tap buttons that add a deposit with amount set to each of 2500.
- a form to add a deposit.
- a list of deposit by day; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
hurried_style: lowercase, abbreviations like pls/txt/mins, 3 to 9 words
fuller_style: two sentences, 20 to 35 words
order: start with who it is for

program:
app "Would you rather" smile plum
table wyr a text, b text
table vote q ref wyr, side pick A|B
state k num = 1
let n = max(count(wyr), 1)
each wyr sort at as w
  if index = k - 1
    stack card gap 1
      w.a head
      "or" faint align center
      w.b head
      row gap 2
        button "A" tap add vote q = w, side = A
        button "B" tap add vote q = w, side = B
      "A" count(w.vote where side = A) "| B" count(w.vote where side = B) faint
button "Next question" tap set k = random(n)
form wyr, "Add question"
describe:
Would you rather, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- wyr: a: text; b: text. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- vote: q: a wyr; side: one of A, B. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- n is the larger of how many wyr entries and 1.
Remembers while you use it: k, starting at 1.
Shows:
- for each wyr sorted by at:
  - if its position is k minus 1:
    - text: the a of the wyr.
    - text: "or".
    - text: the b of the wyr.
    - a button "A"; a tap adds a vote with q set to the wyr, side set to A.
    - a button "B"; a tap adds a vote with q set to the wyr, side set to B.
    - text: "A", how many the wyr's vote entries where side is A, "| B", how many the wyr's vote entries where side is B.
- a button "Next question"; a tap sets k to a random whole number from 1 to n.
- a form to add a wyr.

fuller_style: three short sentences, 20 to 40 words

app "GPA" school plum
table crs name text, grade pick A|B|C|D|F = A, hrs num 1..6 = 3
let pts(g text) = if(g = A, 4, if(g = B, 3, if(g = C, 2, if(g = D, 1, 0))))
let gpa = sum(crs, if(it.grade = A, 4, if(it.grade = B, 3, if(it.grade = C, 2, if(it.grade = D, 1, 0)))) * it.hrs) / max(sum(crs, it.hrs), 1)
round(gpa * 100) / 100 big
draw 100, 5
  rect 0, 0, 100, 5 fill soft radius 2
  rect 0, 0, 25 * gpa, 5 fill accent radius 2
"out of 4.0 over" sum(crs, it.hrs) "credit hours" faint
list crs
form crs
describe:

- crs: name: text; grade: one of A, B, C, D, F, starts at A; hrs: number, 1 to 6, starts at 3. Every entry also keeps when it was added.

- gpa is the sum of 4 when its grade is A, otherwise 3 when its grade is B, otherwise 2 when its grade is C, otherwise 1 when its grade is D, otherwise 0 times its hrs over the crs divided by the larger of the sum of its hrs over the crs and 1.

program:
app "Day planner" calendar ocean
table task what text, done bool
table appt what text, day date = today, at_time time
table shop item text, got bool
table prayer name text, time time
remind "Prayer time" at prayer.time
screen plan "Today" calendar
  count(task where done = no) "tasks left" head
  each appt where day = today sort at_time as a
    row card
      a.at_time bold
      a.what grow
  each task where done = no as t
    row card swipe remove t
      toggle t.done
      t.what grow
  form task, "Add task"
screen appts "Appointments" clock
  each appt where day >= today sort day as a
    row card tap edit a swipe remove a
      a.day a.at_time bold
      a.what grow
  form appt, "Add appointment"
screen shopping "Shopping" cart
  each shop as s
    row card swipe remove s
      toggle s.got
      s.item grow
  form shop, "Add item"
screen prayers "Prayers" mosque
  list prayer
  form prayer, "Add prayer time"
describe:
Day planner, in the ocean colours.
Keeps:
- task: what: text; done: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- appt: what: text; day: date, starts at today; at time: time of day. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- shop: item: text; got: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- prayer: name: text; time: time of day. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- a screen "Today":
  - text: how many task entries where done is no, "tasks left".
  - for each appt where day is today sorted by at time:
    - text: the at time of the appt.
    - text: the what of the appt.
  - for each task where done is no:
    - a group; a swipe removes the task, with undo:
      - a tick box for the done of the task.
      - text: the what of the task.
  - a form to add a task.
- a screen "Appointments":
  - for each appt where day is at least today sorted by day:
    - a group; a tap opens the appt for editing; a swipe removes the appt, with undo:
      - text: the day of the appt, the at time of the appt.
      - text: the what of the appt.
  - a form to add a appt.
- a screen "Shopping":
  - for each shop:
    - a group; a swipe removes the shop, with undo:
      - a tick box for the got of the shop.
      - text: the item of the shop.
  - a form to add a shop.
- a screen "Prayers":
  - a list of prayer; tap one to edit it, swipe to remove it.
  - a form to add a prayer.
Reminder "Prayer time" on each time of the prayer entries.
